hook.note: T3 hero text with C2 punch-in on key word. Use E8 or T7 if hook is framed as a question or prompt.

definition.note: Line-draw/whiteboard reveal or kinetic headline with T8 callout labels.

comparison.note: Split-screen A vs B with T4 keyword emphasis on contrasting traits.

process.note: Diagram build with staggered nodes and arrows. Avoid big T3 headline over diagram.

list_item.note: Numbered cards sliding into progress stack with T4 keyword emphasis.

stat.note: Stat counter or chart reveal. Strictly requires source field per honesty gate.

example_prompt.note: Chat UI bubble or terminal typewriter text. Avoid unrelated metaphor footage.

code.note: Syntax-colored code view with diff highlighting and callouts.

ui_demo.note: Real screen recording with authentic cursor path and punch-in.

myth_fact.note: Two-pane comparison with strike-through on myth and highlight on reality.

analogy.note: Metaphor footage with slow push-in or simple whiteboard line-draw icons.

opinion.note: Metaphor footage or creator screen recording with T4 emphasis; requires original element.

payoff.note: Clean kinetic headline with C2 punch-in. C5/C6 allowed once as climax payoff.

cta.note: Official channel outro card with animated subscribe button conversion.
